feature_set: keyword-regex + AST dangerous-call + AST XSS + AST path-traversal (khong gom code_lines/code_chars)
notes: Khong dung sample_weight balanced vi gay over-correct nghiem trong (SAFE recall giam con 0.12).

Data augmentation bang AST variable-renaming khong cai thien ket qua voi RF/XGBoost vi dac trung khong phu thuoc ten bien; augmentation nay du kien se huu ich hon cho CodeBERT (hoc truc tiep tu token).
CWE-798 co qua it mau (6 train/2 test) - danh gia rieng biet, khong dua vao so sanh dinh luong chinh.
code_lines/code_chars bi loai khoi feature set vi la 'shortcut gia', khong phan anh ban chat lo hong.
